title: Video by nomadatoast
description:
Comment AI for the flash-cut Skill 👇

I turned my viral flash-cut workflow into a reusable creative Skill you can import directly into Lovart. Add your screenshot to tell the agent where you want the effect, and let the workflow do the rest.

You can even connect Pinterest boards and turn your own inspiration into completely new creative Skills.
Lovart has revamped their tool with a crazy agentic AI and it makes it so much easier.
